notes.title: ⛈️ Cloudscrapers x Games Forged in Germany ⛅
notes.notes: [h1]Steam Event: Games Forged in Germany[/h1][p][/p][p]The Games Forged in Germany Steam Event is live from [b]July 24-31[/b] and Cloudscrapers is featured among the upcoming releases! 🎉[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3562200/Cloudscrapers/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]While we don’t have a demo yet and visibility is still growing, we’d love for you to check out our game’s page, wishlist Cloudscrapers, and follow us if you like what you see. Every bit of support helps a small indie team like ours, and sharing the game with others makes a big difference![/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/games-forged-in-germany" style="button"]Games Forged in Germany[/url][/p][p][/p][h2]Newsletter & Discord[/h2][p][/p][p]Make sure to subscribe to our [b]newsletter [/b]and join our[b] Discord[/b] to follow the journey of Cloudscrapers! [/p][p]🎮 Join [b]pre-release playtests[/b][/p][p]🎁 Receive [b]exclusive content & gifts[/b]  [/p][p]🔔 Stay [b]updated[/b] on development[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://cloudscrapersgame.com/" style="button"]Subscribe to Newsletter[/url][/p][h3][url="https://discord.com/invite/fbWana9WE2" style="button"]Join our Discord[/url][/h3][p][/p][h2]Game Recommendation[/h2][p][/p][p]We’d also like to give a shoutout to our friends at Gentle Troll Entertainment: [b]Tavern Talk Stories: Dreamwalker[/b] just dropped a fresh new demo! It’s a brand-new adventure in the [i]Tavern Talk[/i] universe – complete with a new story, a cozy seaside tavern, and revamped gameplay. Don’t miss it! ✨[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3500880/Tavern_Talk_Stories_Dreamwalker/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][i]☁️ See you in the clouds ☁️[/i][/p][p][i]The Cloudscrapers Team[/i][/p]

notes.title: ☁️ Playtest #1 is coming – Register now! 🎮
notes.notes: [h1]Hey, Cloudscraper! ☁️🛠️[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45530066/36ee6017b270a99907ea73513002ec8c9ca4bab9.png"][/img][/p][p]We’re excited to announce that Cloudscrapers is nearly ready for its [b]very first closed playtest[/b] – and you’re invited to take part in it! This is your chance to play an early version of the game and help us improve it with your feedback ✨[/p][p][/p][p]Registrations are [b]NOW OPEN[/b] and will remain available for a couple of weeks. From these we’ll select a first group of testers – if you’d like to be considered, please sign-up to our newsletter to get the playtest invite:[/p][p][/p][h2][b]👉 [/b][url="https://cloudscrapersgame.com"]cloudscrapersgame.com[/url][/h2][p][/p][p]Keep in mind: Cloudscrapers is still in active development. The version you’ll be playing is early, imperfect, and still evolving, but your input at this stage will be incredibly valuable.[/p][p]Participation also requires joining our [url="https://discord.com/invite/fbWana9WE2"][b]Discord[/b][/url] server. That’s where we’ll coordinate everything and gather feedback.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45530066/938df26a26b44e40c7db176ad1e85bf8b4c26615.png"][/img][/p][p]We hope you're as excited to play the game as we are to share it with you! 🤍[/p][p][/p][p][i]☁️ See you in the clouds ☁️[/i][/p][p][i]The Cloudscrapers Team[/i][/p]

The development of [i]Cloudscrapers[/i] is picking up pace, and we're working hard to bring you the best possible demo as the next big step. In the meantime, we’d love your help: Over the coming months, we’ll be running several pre-release playtests to gather feedback and keep making the game even better.
